description: This file defines the Resource interface related to policies in the Eclipse Ditto project, including factory methods for creating resources, JSON serialization, and related constants and metadata.

classes.name: Resource.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions for JSON fields related to Resource, specifically the schema version field.

methods.name: Resource.newInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create new Resource instances with various parameter combinations.

methods.name: Resource.getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for Resource, which is only version V_2.

methods.name: Resource.getResourceKey
methods.description: Retrieves the ResourceKey identifier for this Resource.

methods.name: Resource.getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the resource.

methods.name: Resource.getPath
methods.description: Gets the JSON Pointer representing the path of this resource.

methods.name: Resource.getFullQualifiedPath
methods.description: Returns the combined type and path as the full qualified path.

methods.name: Resource.getEffectedPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with this resource, including granted and revoked ones.
